tools.name: search_charts
tools.description: Find the Chartory chart types that fit a question about the user's data, in plain words ("monthly revenue against target", "where users drop off in signup"). Returns each type's slug, what it answers and its install command.

tools.name: get_chart_spec
tools.description: The component, its props, sizes and the JSON Schema of its data prop, for one chart type by slug (from search_charts). Shape the user's data to the schema.

tools.name: get_chart_code
tools.description: The install command and the component file for one chart type, plus an example file with sample data. Paid types need a Code or Complete licence key sent as the Bearer token.

tools.name: get_tokens
tools.description: Chartory's design tokens (CSS custom properties from chartory.css) in one of the four modes, optionally filtered by a name fragment ("data", "surface", "signal"). Light is :root, dark is .dark; data-theme picks a mode for a subtree.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "get_chart_code" references sensitive artifacts (bearer). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
